name: Possession Magenta
source:
The protagonist, Mihara Suzu, a student at Akarinkai Senior High School (commonly called “Akarin”), was heading towards school with her childhood friends Otonari Kanade and Shizuma Souta, along with her best friend Matsuri Ayame, as per usual. When they arrived at the front gates, they hear a certain story from Akarin High’s student council president, Aoba Taiga:

“The truth is, one of the students has gone missing.”

According to Taiga’s story, during the previous night, an Akarin High School student boy went missing after acting like a different person; behaving violently while he was playing with his friends. Though the story worried them, the bell signalling the beginning of the first class forced them to end the conversation.

The next day, what Suzu and her friends saw in the schoolyard was the boy who went missing. He had a bizarre appearance and was crucified.

A strange incident that plagued the peaceful school.
From there on, a mystery interwoven by love and madness begins. How will it end?

[Translation of the official website's story summary.]
translation:
主角美原铃是赤凛海高中（通常简称“Akarin”）的学生。和往常一样，她与青梅竹马音成奏、静间草太以及好友祭绫女一起前往学校。抵达校门时，她们从Akarin高中学生会会长青叶大河那里听到了一件事：

“事实上，有一名学生失踪了。”

按照大河的说法，前一天晚上，一名Akarin高中男学生表现得像变了个人一样，和朋友玩耍时行为异常暴力，随后失踪了。这个故事让她们感到不安，但第一节课开始的铃声迫使她们结束了谈话。

第二天，铃和朋友们在校园里看到了那个失踪的男孩。他的外表诡异，身体还被钉在十字架上。

一场奇异事件侵扰了这所原本平静的学校。
从那以后，一段交织着爱情与疯狂的谜团就此展开。它将如何结束？

[译自官方网站的剧情简介。]
